//location: This file sits beside tsconfig.app.json ON PURPOSE, not under .replatform-local/. TypeScript resolves default typeRoots and default @types auto-inclusion relative to the config file in use, so a copy under .replatform-local/ silently loses explorers-earth/node_modules/@types (e.g. @types/google.maps -> 125 spurious TS2503/TS2304). Sitting here, every default resolves exactly as the canonical build resolves it. Logs stay under .replatform-local/.
//why-no-overrides: No compilerOptions overrides beyond noEmit/incremental. paths, types, typeRoots and lib are all INHERITED. The author's review configs overrode all four, and two of those overrides caused the reported OOM and the spurious diagnostics:
//cause-1-paths: paths:{} REPLACES tsconfig.app.json's 'zod/v3' -> ./node_modules/zod/v3 mapping. explorersApiClient.ts:16 imports { z } from 'zod/v3'. Installed zod in explorers-earth is 4.3.6. CORRECTED (the earlier wording here was wrong): without the mapping, 'zod/v3' does NOT resolve through zod 4's package exports to the v4 type barrel. --traceResolution shows it resolving UPWARD OUT OF THE APP, to tunes/node_modules/zod/v3 at 3.25.76. The broken arm's program therefore contains TWO structurally distinct zod v3 type identities at once (3.25.76 from the hoisted tunes copy, and 4.3.6 reached through the app's own zod), and it is the structural comparison between those two independent ZodType hierarchies across this schema chain that expands until the heap dies. The conclusion is unchanged - a harness defect, not a defect in explorersApiClient.ts, and no source annotation is needed - but there is NO zod-v4 generic-inference pathology to go hunting for.
//cause-2-lib: lib:["ES2024",...] is rejected by TS 5.6.3 (TS6046 - no lib.es2024 ships) and silently falls back, so the author's configs never meant what they said. Inheriting tsconfig.app.json's ES2020 is correct.
